description: This file defines an interface IProductRepository for managing Product entities, including methods for CRUD operations asynchronously.

classes.name: IProductRepository
classes.description: An interface defining asynchronous methods for product data access, including retrieving all products, getting a product by ID, creating, updating, and deleting products.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Returns a task that provides a read-only list of all products.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Returns a task that provides a product matching the given ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new product asynchronously and returns the created product.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing product identified by ID asynchronously, returning the updated product or null if not found.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a product by ID asynchronously, returning whether the deletion was successful.
